title: Motorcycle industry records best July ever, says Abraciclo
seoTitle: Motorcycles record best July, says Abraciclo
subtitle: Motorcycle production reaches the highest volume ever recorded for the month of July
excerpt: Brazil's motorcycle industry set a record by achieving the highest production volume ever in a July, according to Abraciclo.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Production record

Brazil's motorcycle industry set a record by achieving the highest production volume for a July in its history, as reported by Abraciclo.

The data highlights the sector's productive capacity in July, demonstrating performance superior to any previous July periods.

With information from Agência Brasil.
